user.title: Set up Sonoff SWV-ZFE
user.description: Select the Sonoff SWV-ZFE device as registered by Zigbee2MQTT/MQTT. The stable IEEE address will be extracted automatically and used to link existing MQTT entities.

error.device_not_found: The selected device could not be found in the device registry. Please try again.
error.not_a_zigbee2mqtt_device: The selected device does not look like a Zigbee2MQTT device (no matching MQTT identifier found). Please select the Sonoff SWV-ZFE device registered via Zigbee2MQTT.

abort.already_configured: This Sonoff SWV-ZFE device is already configured.

init.title: Zigbee2MQTT
init.description: Base topic of Zigbee2MQTT ("base_topic" in its configuration). Change it only if it is not "zigbee2mqtt".

error.invalid_base_topic: Enter a topic without "#" or "+", for example zigbee2mqtt.
